legend: Low/intermediate-power view of a dermal nerve sheath myxoma. Note the multinodularity, the rind of fibrous tissue around the nodules, and the abundant myxoid matrix. The neoplastic Schwann cells are arranged in cords and syncytial-like aggregates. Some have a ring-like appearance and resemble fat cells.

legend: An ill-defined, unencapsulated and lobulated dermal proliferation. Tumour lobules are separated by fibrovascular stroma and composed of stellate and spindled cells in a myxoid matrix. Individual cells have pale cytoplasm, indistinct borders, and no atypia.
